mapper.select:
SELECT B.UNQ_KY_VAL, A.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL, A.DIVS_CD, A.PPCD, A.FRM_CFY, CASE WHEN A.FRM_CFY = 'JOB' THEN '작업전' WHEN A.FRM_CFY = 'OZR' THEN '일반' WHEN A.FRM_CFY = 'PDF' THEN '필기' ELSE '' END AS FRM_CFY_NM, A.FRM_NM, B.REGPR_ID, B.REGPR_NM, B.RG_DT, B.TITL_NM, TO_CHAR(B.RG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FM_RG_DT, (SELECT ATFL_GRUP_NM || '/' || ATFL_PHCL_NM || '.' || ATFL_FEXT_NM FROM GE_MP_FILE_S WHERE ATFL_GRUP_NM = 'GE_MP_ETCFRM_M' AND UNQ_NO = A.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL AND ATFL_ID = '1') PDF_FNAME1, (SELECT ATFL_GRUP_NM || '/' || ATFL_PHCL_NM || '.' || ATFL_FEXT_NM FROM GE_MP_FILE_S WHERE ATFL_GRUP_NM = 'GE_MP_ETCFRM_S' AND UNQ_NO = B.UNQ_KY_VAL AND ATFL_ID = '1') OZD_FNAME1 FROM GE_MP_ETCFRM_S B, GE_MP_ETCFRM_M A WHERE A.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL = B.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL AND B.DLT_YN = 'N'
AND A.FRM_CFY = #{FRM_CFY}
AND A.FRM_NM LIKE '%'||#{FRM_NM}||'%'
AND B.REGPR_NM LIKE '%'||#{REGPR_NM}||'%'
ORDER BY B.RG_DT DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GE_MP_ETCFRM_S B, GE_MP_ETCFRM_M A WHERE A.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL = B.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL AND B.DLT_YN = 'N'
AND A.FRM_CFY = #{FRM_CFY}
AND A.FRM_NM LIKE '%'||#{FRM_NM}||'%'
AND B.REGPR_NM LIKE '%'||#{REGPR_NM}||'%'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GE_MP_ETCFRM_S ( UNQ_KY_VAL, FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL, FRM_CFY, TITL_NM, REGPR_ID, REGPR_NM, RG_DT, DLT_YN ) VALUES ( #{UNQ_KY_VAL}, #{FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL}, #{FRM_CFY}, #{TITL_NM}, #{REGPR_ID}, #{REGPR_NM}, SYSDATE, 'N' )
mapper.update: UPDATE GE_MP_ETCFRM_S SET TITL_NM = #{TITL_NM}, RG_DT = SYSDATE WHERE UNQ_KY_VAL = #{UNQ_KY_VAL}
mapper.delete: UPDATE GE_MP_ETCFRM_S SET DLT_YN = 'Y' WHERE UNQ_KY_VAL IN(${CHK_ITEMS})
mapper.select: SELECT UNQ_KY_VAL, FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL, FRM_CFY, TITL_NM, REGPR_ID, REGPR_NM, RG_DT, TO_CHAR(RG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FM_RG_DT FROM GE_MP_ETCFRM_S WHERE UNQ_KY_VAL = #{UNQ_KY_VAL}
